text: 四十岁了，女人最好的年龄已经过去，看看自己，留下的什么？
en: Forty years old, a woman's best years have already passed; look at oneself—what is left behind?

text: 发黄的皮肤，深深地法令纹，眼角的细纹，当然我们收货的也很多，再我们不停的老去的时间里，让我们从容面对吧！
en: Yellowing skin, deep nasolabial folds, fine lines at the corners of the eyes—of course we have gained a great deal too; in this time of our ceaseless ageing, let us face it with composure!

text: 心态时刻要年轻，这个年龄了，上有老下有小，是个尴尬得年龄，不过，这个时候保养自己更重要！
en: One must keep a youthful mindset at all times. At this age, with the elderly above and the young below, it is an awkward age—but at this time, taking care of oneself is all the more important!

text: 总要为自己活嘛！
en: One must live for oneself, after all!

text: 舍得投资自己的女人才是中年人该有的姿态，投资自己，丰盈自己，心态固然好了，自然而然，气色就好了，所以说，中年人为自己活吧！
en: A woman willing to invest in herself is the very posture a middle-aged person ought to have. Invest in oneself, enrich oneself; one's mindset naturally improves, and naturally one's complexion improves too. So, middle-aged people, live for yourselves!

text: 特别是中年得女人，我们还有多少好看的时间！
en: Especially for middle-aged women—how much time do we have left to look good!

text: 83年，中英澳美四国生活教育背景，美国top30s 教育管理博士。
en: Born in 1983, with life and educational backgrounds across four countries—China, Britain, Australia and America; a PhD in educational management from a US top-30 institution.

text: 自己有留美咨询公司，在波士顿附近一所私立寄宿美高做副校长。
en: Runs a US-study consultancy of her own, and serves as vice-principal at a private boarding American high school near Boston.

text: 我的体会是：
en: My reflections are as follows:

text: 一. 夫妻和睦非常重要；
en: First, marital harmony is extremely important;

text: 二. 夫妻需要一起管理孩子；熊孩子七岁，钢琴和国际象棋，妈妈负责管理，我负责开车接送；
en: Second, husband and wife need to manage the children together; our naughty seven-year-old takes piano and chess—Mum is in charge of managing, and I am in charge of driving him to and fro;

text: 三. 做好家庭财务规划；
en: Third, draw up a sound family financial plan;

text: 四. 要有家庭的时间，出去玩几天，乐园等，强化家庭联系；
en: Fourth, make time for the family—go away for a few days, to a theme park and so on—to strengthen family bonds;

text: 五. 父母的健康很重要，早点做好体检。
en: Fifth, parents' health is very important; get check-ups done early.

text: 六. 人到中年，要经得住诱惑，财色名利。
en: Sixth, reaching middle age, one must withstand temptation—wealth, sex, fame and fortune.

text: 酸甜苦辣咸尝了个遍，蜡烛着了一半，好时光剩不多了，如果再不努力，一生就平平淡淡过去了。
en: Tasted sour, sweet, bitter, spicy and salty to the full; the candle is half burnt down; not much good time remains. If one does not strive now, life will simply pass by in bland ordinariness.

text: 中年男人的危机？
en: The middle-aged man's crisis?

text: 其实有很多哦。
en: Actually, there are quite a lot.

text: 精力和体力不济了，一般来说，45岁是一个坎，过了这个坎，体力和精力会有一个断崖式的下降，你会发现自己再也不是哪个怎么折腾都不出问题的钢筋铁骨了，经常会发出“力不能逮”的感叹。
en: One's energy and stamina fail. Generally speaking, forty-five is a threshold; once past it, physical strength and energy plummet in a cliff-edge decline. You realise you are no longer that iron-clad body which could be tossed about without any trouble, and often you sigh that one's strength falls short of what is required.

text: 中年一般都得各种慢性病，高血压、糖尿病、高尿酸、脊椎和颈椎还有膝盖的问题，就要吃药，就要忌口，注意起居，改良生活习惯，你发现你再也不能向年轻时候习惯性刷夜，大块吃肉，大碗喝酒，快意人生，生活出现很多的限制，总让你顿生“吃不能吃，喝不能喝，玩不能玩，活着有啥意思”的哀叹。
en: Middle-aged people generally develop various chronic illnesses—high blood pressure, diabetes, high uric acid, problems with the spine, cervical vertebrae and knees. You must take medicine, must avoid certain foods, pay attention to your daily routine, and improve your habits. You find you can no longer, as in youth, routinely stay up all night, eat meat in great chunks, drink wine by the bowl and live life to the full. Life acquires many restrictions, always prompting the lament: 'cannot eat what one wants, cannot drink what one wants, cannot play as one wishes—what is the point of living?'

text: 中年男人往往会失去对异性的吸引力，想当年怒马轻裘，黑发如漆，目如点墨；当下眼袋尽显，头发稀疏，走在街上，年轻人的往往称呼你师傅，还有更小的叫你大爷，总让你有一种不太适应的感觉，好像自己正处于已经在向一个糟老头子过渡的阶段，再也不会有美女对你回眸一笑，你也永远失去了年轻人的那种矫情和想如非非，因为明白：飞花雪月之类的，似乎和自己没啥关系了。
en: The middle-aged man often loses his attractiveness to the opposite sex. Think back to those years—spirited horse and light furs, black hair like lacquer, eyes like dots of ink. Now eye-bags are fully on show and hair is thinning; walking down the street, young people often call you 'master', and the even younger call you 'old man'. It always gives you an unsettling feeling, as if you are already in the stage of transitioning into a wretched old codger—never again will a beauty turn and smile at you. And you have forever lost that youthful affectation and those wandering, improper fancies, because you understand: things like drifting blossoms and falling snow seem to have nothing to do with you anymore.

text: 在更现实的同时，也夹杂着很多的失落。
en: Alongside becoming more realistic, there is also much disillusionment mixed in.

text: 中年人有时候看问题看得太透了，一眼从表象看出了本质，也就使生活失去了太多的乐趣和嚼头。
en: Middle-aged people sometimes see things too clearly; with one glance they see the essence beneath the surface, and that robs life of too much pleasure and savour.

text: 世道人心，想来无非如此，没有什么是真正值得去追求的，也没有什么是真正值得去信仰的，到最后人无非就是为了活着而活着，这也就使中年人的生活变成了简单机械的重复，
en: The ways of the world and of people—on reflection, it is ever thus. There is nothing truly worth pursuing, nothing truly worth believing in. In the end, people merely live in order to live, and that turns the middle-aged person's life into a simple, mechanical repetition,

text: 了无生趣，你可以说这种心态是勘破世情，但这样也使人的心境变得极度的无聊和伧俗：人与人之间的关系无非利益的交换；人生其实没有什么意义，
en: Utterly devoid of joy, you might call this mindset having seen through the ways of the world—but it also makes one's state of mind extremely bored and vulgar: the relationships between people are nothing but exchanges of interest; life in truth has no meaning,

text: 意义都是自己自作多情给自己找的，问题还在于，你就算看破了这些，还必须去过这种生活，很多事情，你早知道结局，但还必须去走这个过程，
en: Meaning is all something one imposes on oneself out of self-indulgence. The problem is, even having seen through all this, you must still live this life; many things, you know the ending long beforehand, yet must still go through the process,

text: 没有了对未来的期许和对未知的好奇，生活也就失去了加速的动力。
en: With no more expectation of the future and no curiosity about the unknown, life loses the drive to accelerate.

text: 中年人心态的另一方面在于孤独。
en: Another aspect of the middle-aged mindset lies in loneliness.

text: 你渐渐明白，这个世界上，你自己的问题永远都只有你自己去抗，没人能够真正的帮得了你，包括你的父母家人和朋友。
en: Gradually you understand that in this world your own problems are forever yours alone to bear; no one can truly help you, not even your parents, family or friends.

text: 年轻的时候，有父母的庇护，社会单位上，有一群朋友互壮胆色，但其实哪个时候，自己的问题其实也是只有你去面对，但那会对这些想得还不是太透，现在想透了，自己也是孤家寡人，心理的苦只有自己吞，生活的担子只有自己去抗，没人能真正理解你和替你分担，父母年龄大了，孩子还小，当年朋友三四早已散落无踪，就算还有联系，大家都各自讨生活，你没有一个人和一个空间可以倾述，一觉醒来，该自己去面对还是自己去面对。
en: In youth, there was the shelter of parents, and at the workplace a circle of friends to bolster one another's courage. But in truth, even then your problems were yours alone to face; it is just that back then you had not thought it through so clearly. Now that you have, you see you are also utterly alone—the bitterness in your heart only you can swallow, the burden of life only you can bear. No one can truly understand you or share your load. Parents are aged, children still young; the few friends of former years have long scattered without trace. Even if some remain in contact, everyone is busy making their own living. You have no one and no space to confide in; wake up and it is still you who must face it alone.

text: 这就是生活对于一个中年人的残酷。
en: This is the cruelty of life towards a middle-aged person.

text: 对于一个中年人来说，一般在各种的单位和事业上都到了一个瓶颈，不会有太多的发展空间，以后的日子往往是每况愈下，效率值走低的趋势，就算你非常努力，也就维持一个差强人意的局面，但是单位里上级不会给你苟延残喘的机会，后来人气势汹汹想取而代之，这就是一个进退维谷的局面：对工作和事业没有了太多的热情和冲劲，勉力维持，免不了的摸鱼和划水，但职场竞争的激烈和知识更替优胜劣汰的竞争规律总让人狼狈不堪，捉襟见肘。
en: For a middle-aged person, one has generally reached a bottleneck in various workplaces and careers; there is not much room for advancement, and the days ahead tend to go from bad to worse, with efficiency on a downward trend. Even if you strive very hard, you only sustain a barely satisfactory situation. Yet superiors at the workplace will not give you the chance to linger on in decline; those who come after press forward aggressively, eager to replace you. This is a predicament of being stuck between advance and retreat: no longer much passion or drive for work and career, merely holding on, inevitably slacking and coasting—yet the fierce competition of the workplace and the law of survival of the fittest through constant knowledge renewal leave one perpetually dishevelled and strapped for resources.

text: 如果说具体的单位和体制是一个一个的小机器，社会职场乃至人生其实就一个又一个的大机器。
en: If the concrete workplaces and systems are one small machine after another, then society, the workplace and indeed life itself are in fact one great machine after another.

text: 中年人有点像已经到最大使用效率值的零件，离完全老化还有一段比较长的时间，但每年发挥的效力都在下降，而且被严重分散:你要担心自己的衰老，维护自己身体，操心老人的病情，苦恼孩子的学习和就业，不断修补和爱人的感情和婚姻，还要在职场上打拼和各路牛鬼蛇神打交道，很多时候分身乏术，好像什么都在做，但每一样都没有做好，往往是一波未平一波又起，人总是处于一种焦灼和烦躁的状态而且没有安全感的状态之中疲于应付。
en: The middle-aged person is a bit like a component that has already reached its maximum efficiency value; there is still a fairly long time before complete obsolescence, but the effectiveness exerted each year keeps declining, and is severely fragmented: you must worry about your own ageing, maintain your body, fret over your elderly's illnesses, be troubled by your child's studies and employment, constantly patch up the feelings and marriage with your spouse, and still strive in the workplace and deal with all manner of troublesome characters. Many a time you are pulled in too many directions to cope—it seems you are doing everything, yet nothing well; often one wave has not settled before another rises, and one is forever wearily responding from a state of anxiety, irritation and insecurity.

text: 回顾过往，看一下当下，突然觉得人生如果是二段式的，其实中年应该是一个分水岭，之前从出生到求学到工作，是一个个人价值不断增长的过程。
en: Looking back on the past and taking stock of the present, it suddenly occurs to me that if life were two-stage, then middle age should be a watershed: the period before it, from birth to study to work, is a process of ever-growing personal value.

text: 因为社会需要新人来填充到社会大机器的每一个部位上，就会给你机会学习和增长自己的价值，学习和工作其实是磨练你增值的手段，但一个人不会永远增值，
en: Because society needs new people to fill every part of the great social machine, it gives you the chance to learn and increase your value; study and work are in truth the means by which you are tempered and appreciate in value—but a person cannot appreciate forever,

text: 他总有饱和的那一刻，因为每一个都有自己的上限，而人到中年往往是很多人的上限，在之前因为个人价值的提升，社会也不断给你增加负担，
en: There comes a moment of saturation, for everyone has their own ceiling, and reaching middle age is often the ceiling for many. Before this, as personal value rose, society kept adding burdens to you as well,

text: 在工作上你担更多的责任，你会组建家庭，就有家庭负担，但另一个方面，当你中年走下坡路时，这些负担却并没有同时减轻，有时候反而愈加的沉重，
en: At work you take on more responsibility; you form a family and acquire its burdens. Yet on the other hand, when you decline in middle age, these burdens do not lighten at the same time—sometimes they grow all the heavier,

text: 这在其中总有一种无法回避的错位：就是人是越来越老，社会要求却越来越高，生活担子也越来越重。
en: Within this lies an inescapable dislocation: people grow ever older, yet society's demands grow ever higher, and the burden of life ever heavier.

text: 要问中年危机怎么破？
en: If you ask how to break the middle-aged crisis?

text: 其实又能怎么破呢？
en: In truth, how could one break it?

text: 它就是人在这个阶段必须面对的问题，如果说错位是一个人生BUG，你也只有背负着它走完这断旅程。
en: It is simply the problem one must face at this stage of life. If this dislocation is a bug of life, you can only carry it on your back and walk to the end of this journey.

text: 等到你真正年老退休只时，身上担负的超负荷压力顿减，变得和自己的身体状况相适应。
en: Only when you are truly old and retired does the overloaded pressure you bear suddenly ease, becoming adapted to your physical condition.

text: 这个世界很多问题都是这样，它永远得不到真正的解决，只有等时间的推移，让问题不成其为问题，也许这就是人到中年必须面对的无奈。
en: Many problems in this world are like this: they are never truly solved; one can only wait for the passage of time to make the problem cease to be a problem. Perhaps this is the helplessness that one, reaching middle age, must face.
